protocol_overview.type: Memory-mapped register interface (AHCI register set behind PCI BAR5/ABAR) plus per-port DMA engine that exchanges Frame Information Structures (FISes) with a directly-attached SATA device (or a Port Multiplier fanning out to up to 15 devices) over a Gen 1 (1.5 Gbps) / Gen 2 (3 Gbps) / Gen 3 (6 Gbps) Serial ATA link with 8b/10b encoding, embedded clocking, and 32-bit CRC on the FIS payload.
protocol_overview.duplex: full-duplex on the wire (independent TX A+/A- and RX B+/B- differential pairs); FIS-level traffic is half-duplex within a given primitive sequence
protocol_overview.host_role: Bus master to system memory + bus master / link initiator on every SATA port. Software programs Command Headers + Command Tables + PRDs in system memory then sets the matching bit in PxCI; the HBA's port DMA engine handles transport.
protocol_overview.device_role: SATA device (HDD / SSD / ATAPI ODD) connected to one HBA port (directly or via Port Multiplier). Issues D2H Register FIS / DMA Activate FIS / DMA Setup FIS / Data FIS / PIO Setup FIS / Set Device Bits FIS / BIST Activate FIS in response to Command FISes.

functional_requirements.text: An AHCI HBA shall support from 1 to 32 SATA ports; CAP.NP (zero-based) and PI (Ports Implemented) shall identify which ports are present and which are available to software.
AHCI memory-mapped registers shall reside in a non-cacheable memory region addressed by the AHCI Base Address Register (ABAR = PCI BAR5, offset 24h in PCI Configuration Space).

Below offset 100h within ABAR shall be Generic Host Control (CAP / GHC / IS / PI / VS / CCC_CTL / CCC_PORTS / EM_LOC / EM_CTL / CAP2 / BOHC); at offset 100h + (port × 80h) shall be the per-port register bank (PxCLB / PxCLBU / PxFB / PxFBU / PxIS / PxIE / PxCMD / PxTFD / PxSIG / PxSSTS / PxSCTL / PxSERR / PxSACT / PxCI / PxSNTF / PxFBS / PxDEVSLP / PxVS).
Each implemented port shall have a Command List of 1-32 Command Headers (each 32 B) in system memory pointed to by PxCLB[H32] / PxCLBU[U32], aligned to a 1 KB boundary.

Each implemented port shall have a Received FIS Structure in system memory pointed to by PxFB / PxFBU, aligned to 256 B (or 4 KB when FIS-Based Switching is enabled), carrying DSFIS (DMA Setup) / PSFIS (PIO Setup) / RFIS (D2H Register) / SDBFIS (Set Device Bits) / UFIS (Unknown, up to 64 B) sub-areas.

Each Command Header shall point to a Command Table in system memory containing CFIS (Command FIS — up to 64 B, valid lengths 2-16 Dwords), ACMD (12 or 16 B ATAPI command), Reserved (48 B), and PRDT (Physical Region Descriptor Table of 0-65,535 entries).

Each Physical Region Descriptor (PRD) shall be 16 B containing DBA (Data Base Address, 32-bit, word-aligned), DBAU (upper 32 b if CAP.S64A=1), Reserved, and Description Information (Interrupt-on-Completion I bit at DW3[31] + 22-bit Data Byte Count up to 4 MB / entry, DBC[0] must be 1 for even byte count).

The HBA shall transport the following FIS types: 0x27 Register Host-to-Device (H2D), 0x34 Register Device-to-Host (D2H), 0x39 DMA Activate, 0x41 DMA Setup, 0x46 Data, 0x58 BIST Activate, 0x5F PIO Setup, 0xA1 Set Device Bits.

The integrated SATA Transport / Link / PHY shall perform Out-Of-Band signaling — COMRESET (host-initiated) → COMINIT (device-response) → COMWAKE (handshake) → ALIGN-symbol detection → speed negotiation between Gen 1 (1.5 Gbps), Gen 2 (3 Gbps), Gen 3 (6 Gbps) — before the link reaches the L0 state in which FISes flow.

Software shall issue a command by setting the corresponding PxCI[slot] bit; the HBA shall fetch the Command Header, fetch the Command Table, transmit the CFIS to the device, manage Data / Setup / Set-Device-Bits FISes for that command, and clear PxCI[slot] on completion (and PxSACT[slot] for NCQ commands).
The HBA shall maintain a shadow of the device's Task File in PxTFD (Status + Error); BSY = bit 7, DRQ = bit 3, ERR = bit 0 of STS; ERR field reflects the most recent D2H Register FIS Error byte.
PxSSTS shall reflect SCR0 SStatus — DET[3:0] (no device / device but no Phy / device + Phy / offline), SPD[3:0] (Gen 1/2/3), IPM[3:0] (idle / Active / Partial / Slumber / DevSleep).
PxSCTL shall control SCR2 SControl — DET (no action / COMRESET / disable), SPD (cap maximum negotiated speed), IPM (allow all / disable Partial / disable Slumber / disable both).

PxSERR shall record SCR1 SError — including PxSERR.DIAG.X (Exchanged, indicates device presence change), PxSERR.DIAG.N (PhyRdy change), PxSERR.DIAG.F (Unknown FIS), CRC, Handshake, Internal, etc., write-1-to-clear semantics.

When CAP.SNCQ = 1, the HBA shall support Native Command Queuing — software shall set PxSACT[slot] before / together with PxCI[slot]; the HBA shall track outstanding NCQ commands per slot and clear PxSACT[slot] only when the device returns a Set Device Bits FIS with that slot bit set.
The HBA shall tolerate hot insertion and hot removal — PxSSTS.DET transitions shall set PxSERR.DIAG.X and PxIS.PCS (Port Connect Change Status), gated by PxIE for interrupt generation.
PxCMD.ICC shall accept interface power state requests: 1h Active, 2h Partial, 6h Slumber, 8h DevSleep (CAP2.SDS=1 required); the HBA shall report the current state in PxSSTS.IPM.

When CAP.CCCS = 1, the HBA shall implement Command Completion Coalescing — CCC_CTL.TV timeout + CCC_CTL.CC completion count gate a single CCC interrupt instead of per-port completion interrupts, with CCC_PORTS selecting which ports participate.
When CAP.EMS = 1, the HBA shall implement Enclosure Management — EM_LOC + EM_CTL global registers, supporting LED / SAF-TE / SES-2 / SGPIO message types.
When CAP2.BOH = 1, the HBA shall implement the BIOS/OS Handoff mechanism — BOHC register with BOS (BIOS Owned Semaphore) + OOS (OS Owned Semaphore) + SOOE + OOC + BB to coordinate ownership.

When CAP.FBSS = 1 and PxFBS.EN = 1, the HBA shall route received FISes by Port Multiplier Port (PMP) field — DSFIS / PSFIS / RFIS / SDBFIS / UFIS sub-areas are per-PMP within the per-port Received FIS Structure (256 B → 4 KB).

configurations.name: Single-port direct-attach
configurations.description: One AHCI port → one SATA device, no Port Multiplier; PxFBS.EN = 0.

configurations.name: Single-port + Port Multiplier (Command-Based Switching)
configurations.description: CAP.SPM = 1, PxFBS.EN = 0. Software issues one command at a time, parameterized by PMP.

configurations.name: Single-port + Port Multiplier (FIS-Based Switching)
configurations.description: CAP.FBSS = 1, PxFBS.EN = 1. HBA tracks multiple outstanding commands across multiple Port Multiplier ports concurrently.

configurations.name: Multi-port (1-32 ports)
configurations.description: PI register selects which ports are available; each port has its own independent register bank + DMA engine.

configurations.name: AHCI-mode only (CAP.SAM = 1)
configurations.description: Legacy task-file register interface not supported; GHC.AE is read-only 1.

configurations.name: AHCI + Legacy SFF-8038i (CAP.SAM = 0)
configurations.description: HBA supports both legacy IDE/bus-master IDE and AHCI; software switches via GHC.AE.

error_response_conditions: Task File Error — PxTFD.STS.ERR set or PxTFD.STS.BSY/DRQ unexpected → PxIS.TFES set → if enabled, interrupt → software reads PxTFD.ERR and Received FIS for diagnosis.
Host Bus Fatal Error — HBA encountered an unrecoverable host-bus error (target/master abort) → PxIS.HBFS, port stops.
Host Bus Data Error — uncorrectable host-bus data error (ECC / parity) → PxIS.HBDS.
Interface Fatal Error — SATA link error on which the transfer stopped → PxIS.IFS + matching PxSERR bit (CRC / Handshake / Internal / etc.).
Interface Non-fatal Error — recoverable link error → PxIS.INFS.
Overflow Status — device delivered more bytes than the PRD table specified → PxIS.OFS.
Incorrect Port Multiplier Status — FIS received from a device with no outstanding command → PxIS.IPMS.
Unknown FIS — FIS type not 0x34 / 0x39 / 0x41 / 0x46 / 0x58 / 0x5F / 0xA1 / 0x27, copied to UFIS region, PxSERR.DIAG.F + PxIS.UFS.
Port Connect Change — PxSSTS.DET transition → PxSERR.DIAG.X + PxIS.PCS.
Cold Port Detect — PxSSTS detects a connection-status change via cold-presence-detect logic → PxIS.CPDS (only if PxCMD.CPD = 1).
PhyRdy Change — PhyRdy signal toggled → PxSERR.DIAG.N + PxIS.PRCS.
Mechanical Presence Status — mechanical presence switch activated → PxIS.DMPS (CAP.SMPS + PxCMD.MPSP = 1).
compliance_requirements: Hardware shall return 0 for all bits and registers marked as Reserved; software shall write all reserved bits with the value 0.
Register accesses to the memory-mapped AHCI registers shall have a maximum size of 64 bits; 64-bit accesses must not cross an 8-byte alignment boundary; locked accesses are not supported.
Software shall set GHC.AE = 1 before accessing other AHCI registers when CAP.SAM = 0; clearing GHC.AE to 0 requires writing 0x00000000 to GHC (no other bits may be set in the same operation).
Software shall not read or write registers within unavailable ports (PI bit cleared).
Software shall set PxCMD.FRE = 1 (FIS Receive Enable) before setting PxCMD.ST = 1 (Start); software shall clear PxCMD.ST and wait for PxCMD.CR=0 before clearing PxCMD.FRE.
Software shall not issue a command with PRDTL = 0 unless no data transfer is required.
Software shall set PxSCTL.DET = 1 (COMRESET) for at least 1 ms before clearing back to 0 to perform a port reset.
Software shall not modify PxCLB / PxCLBU / PxFB / PxFBU while PxCMD.ST = 1 or PxCMD.FRE = 1.
